main_text.head: FRANC. HOTOMANI IVRISC. INSTITVTIONIS DIALECTICÆ LIBER PRIMVS.
Dialectica & Logica definitio.
CAP. I.
main_text.p: QVID est Dialectica? Est ars, quæ ex cuiusq; rei & verbi af-fectione diuidédi, definiendi, & argumentandi ratione commõstrat: quæ eadem & Logica vulgò nominatur.

Quid est Rei & verbi affectio? Est ratio, quam quæque res & dictio habet ad alteram. Vt Homo est species animalis: Membrum est pars corporis. Græci λόγον appellant. Itaque commodius Rationem appellare possemus. Sed vitandæ ambiguitatis caussa nomen Affe-ctionis delegimus: quo eodé Cicero & in Topicis & in Partitionibus hac eadem in re est usus. Rationis autem verbum à Mathematicis sumptum est, qui λόγον definiunt duarum eiusdem generis quantitatum comparationem. Interpretes Proportione Latinè nominárunt: quidam Habitudinem: nonnulli Habitū: qui

page.notes: The large woodcut initial at the start of the chapter is a decorative Q-shaped letter; the first word is read as QVID. The "Q" of the woodcut is inferred and marked here, not certain. Printed "Affe-" and "af-" hyphens are kept as printed. The Greek λόγον is copied as printed. Spelling is modernised only for u/v and i/j and long s; æ, ò, Latinè and Habitū are kept as printed.
